settings.label: Everyday things for dogs and cats
settings.heading: For the life you share

settings.text: The best of life with a dog or cat is ordinary: the walk, the bowl,
settings.accent: the warm spot on the sofa.

settings.label: The collection
settings.heading: Useful, and good to live with.

settings.name: Breakfast
settings.title: Breakfast, unhurried.
settings.text: The kettle on, a bowl on the floor, and a dog who has been up for an hour already.
settings.image_alt: A golden retriever waiting by its bowl in a farmhouse kitchen, with kibble scattered on the floor

settings.name: Midday
settings.title: The quiet middle.
settings.text: The house to themselves. A patch of sun on the floorboards, and a long sleep in it.
settings.image_alt: A grey cat curled up asleep in a patch of sunlight on a wooden floor

settings.name: Home again
settings.title: Back through the door.
settings.text: Keys down, coat on the hook, and the best welcome of the day.
settings.image_alt: A golden retriever looking up at its owner's muddy boots in a hallway

settings.name: Late
settings.title: Lights down.
settings.text: A last look at the garden, then the warm end of the sofa.
settings.image_alt: A grey cat curled up on a cushion on the sofa in the warm light of a lamp
